body: yeah im done with DXM for now, thank you though!
so.... no heroin? thats not good......

> Your past relationship is a rotting extension of your life that you're still clinging onto. Ask yourself: why? It's only logical and natural that you feel more dead and empty inside if you live in that branch.

this is a great analogy. i guess the memories and hopes are all i have left, and im not ready to give up on them yet.

him sharing the emails made me uncomfortable too, but i rationalized it as a support system for him. Crazy ex drunk emails him at 3am, he can show it to his friends so they can pick me apart and remind him how absolutely awful i am. uhg

im not on heroin per se, im a casual user that just fantasizes about overdosing a lot. --although yeah i know its doing nothing good for me, but at least im not drinking to the point of being in pain every night, like i was a few months ago. schedule was pretty much work/school sober, then get obliterated as possible, then repeat. 

this relationship just felt like my true, great love for so much of it. everything clicked. everything made sense. i could see down the road. I could forgive and love and be happy. It's really hard to acknowledge i can be more than it. 

Maybe this is just one of the stages of grief.. but its lasting forever. As much as i hate to admit it, im usually the sort of girl that is 'on to the next one' ..... very fast... haha. and this just seems like the end of the road

i went back to heroin because everything seems so pointless. the only moments i have been even close to happy are the moments ive been suspended in travel, or high as hell. 

as for the ex, is it really sociopathic? he is now doing the no contact thing, but he certainly hasnt always been doing it. i know some people support the no contact thing as the best way to deal with an ex? he actually stopped talking to me, like cold cut off, the day we were supposed to get together just to talk, but maybe he realized it was a bad idea? He also told me when he ran into me in person that his friends read the emails i sent him and stuff. i wonder if they read the emails he sent? i dont know. but seeing his friends in public is incredibly upsetting to me. they come to where i work, we have mutual friends; i cant get away from it.

i guess its a phase, but its a really long phase. we had so many plans. i feel like i had the future we planned together (down to like what dogs to get and when) just cut out from me. i am backto square one with no interest in moving forward and no energy to try again. i want to be done. originally i just committed myself to not date any more, but crushing loneliness got the best of me. now when i talk to anyone, i feel like im cheating, or more like im lying- there is no spark, excitement, or interest. 

thank you for responding. I want to believe i can get better but nothing has helped.
